    {"topic": "TypeScript patterns", "reminder": "Always check array access with rows[0]"},
    {"topic": "Database patterns", "reminder": "Use uuid_generate_v4() for new records"}
  ],
  "findings": [...],
  "overallScore": 85,
  ...
}
